description: This file defines data models for a fashion retail platform, including Product, CartItem, UserSession, and OrderSummary.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: Represents a garment product with attributes like id, name, description, price, image URL, and category.

classes.name: CartItem
classes.description: Models an item in the shopping cart, including the product and quantity, with a computed line total.

classes.name: UserSession
classes.description: Captures user session details such as user ID, email, and authentication token.

classes.name: OrderSummary
classes.description: Provides a summary of an order including order ID, total amount in cents, and item count.

methods.name: lineTotalCents
methods.description: Computes the total price in cents for the CartItem by multiplying product price with quantity.
